b7fa52d41d706c38.title: Writing with the Poetry of Queer Ancestors with City of West Hollywood Poet Laureate Jen Cheng — In-Person Program
b7fa52d41d706c38.desc: Poems from Pat Parker, Benjamin Alire Sáenz, Andrea Gibson, Alan Ginsberg, and others will inspire our own writing in this class. No experience needed, just bring your writing instruments and come with curiosity! Light refreshments provided by the Friends of the West Hollywood Library. Jen Cheng is the fifth Poet Laureate of West Hollywood, author of a poetry collection Braided Spaces , a Poet Laureate Fellow with The Academy of American Poets, a California Arts Council Fellow, and a Tin House Workshop alumna. She is a multidisciplinary artist who blends East-West influences as Feng Shui Poetry. She is a teaching artist with writing centers such as The Poetry Society of New York, The Loft Literary Center, and UCLA Extension. Connect with her on social media @JenCvoice or at www.JenCvoice.com . Attendance is limited and advance registration is required. Please register every individual in your party. b79849e93fd39ac2.desc: Ned Newley doesn’t even want to be governor. He’s terrified of public speaking; his poll numbers are impressively bad.
